products.description: Surface Thunderbolt 4 Dock connects over USB4/Thunderbolt 4 for up to 40 Gbps data transfer, supports two 4K monitors at 60 Hz, and delivers up to 96W of power passthrough from its 165W supply. It offers eight connections including USB-C, USB-A, 2.5 Gbps Ethernet and audio.
products.keywords: surface thunderbolt 4 dock usb4 docking station dual 4k

products.name: Microsoft Surface USB4 Dock
products.summary: Surface USB4 Dock with 40 Gbps transfer, dual 4K monitor support and up to 65W power passthrough via a captive USB-C cable.
products.description: Surface USB4 Dock works with USB-C and USB4/Thunderbolt 4 devices, offering up to 40 Gbps data speeds, dual 4K monitor support and up to 65W of power passthrough from its 100W USB-C supply. It adds USB-C, USB-A, HDMI and Ethernet ports in a 206 g package with a captive cable.
products.keywords: surface usb4 dock usb-c hub thunderbolt compatible

products.name: Microsoft Xbox Series X

products.description: Xbox Series X is Microsoft's most powerful console, with an 8-core custom Zen 2 CPU at 3.8 GHz, a 12 TFLOPS custom RDNA 2 GPU, 16 GB GDDR6 and a 1 TB custom NVMe SSD. It targets true 4K gaming at up to 120 FPS, supports HDMI 2.1 VRR and ALLM, and includes a 4K UHD Blu-ray drive.
